mission: Make every Mastery Data Pack a structured knowledge system, not only a dataset, by bundling the lawful database, book/reference, API, library, workflow, troubleshooting, evaluation and provenance knowledge needed to use the subject in practice.

book_reference_knowledge: library/purchase references for copyrighted works that cannot be redistributed

composition_rule: A pack may omit a layer only when that layer is genuinely not applicable and the omission is recorded with a reason.
book_rights_rule: Do not copy copyrighted books, movies, courses, scripts or manuals into a package without rights. Use bibliographies, metadata, lawful excerpts within policy, public-domain/open-license works, or user-provided licensed content.
api_secret_rule: Store API schemas/examples and sandbox instructions, never user secrets or provider credentials inside a distributable pack.
truth_rule: A knowledge layer is considered present only when the package contains validated references/assets and its rights/provenance metadata; naming a layer does not prove completeness.
